pages.text: After market, they washed the boat floor, scooping water and splashing it across.
Bung picked up a big scoop. "Let us finish quickly and play, Ddori."
Ddori tried to dip a small scoop into the bucket. Bung's hand got there first. Splash! "I will do it all."
Bung scooped again and again. The arms soon grew heavy.
Ddori tried again. Bung's hand came first again. Ddori's scoop was always empty.
Bung kept resting sore arms. Half the floor still needed washing.
Ddori tugged Bung's clothes and whined. Now Bung could not scoop either.
Grandpa pushed the bucket between them and stepped back. "If you do everything, what does Ddori do?"
Bung poured water into Ddori's scoop. Now there were two scoops.
The boat floor shone clean. Bung and Ddori went to the bow. Grandpa followed.
